tools.name: api_index
tools.description: Full index of the HookPulse API.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Liveness.

tools.name: create_guest
tools.description: Creates a guest token hp_…

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: Lists the guest's/session's endpoints.

tools.name: create_endpoint
tools.description: Creates a dead-man endpoint. Use cron+tz+grace_sec for a real schedule (mutually exclusive with interval_sec) or interval_sec for plain silence detection. max_duration_sec alerts when a run opened by /in/:id/start hangs. May return 402 x402 when it leaves the free tier.

tools.name: import_crontab
tools.description: Reads a crontab and proposes one monitor per scheduled line. Without apply=1 nothing is written; the proposal says what was ignored and why. Passwords in the command are redacted.

tools.name: get_endpoint
tools.description: Status of one endpoint (use the endpoint token if you have it).

tools.name: delete_endpoint
tools.description: Removes the owner's endpoint.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Latest ingest pings.

tools.name: ping_ingest
tools.description: Simulates the cron: GET on /in/:id.

tools.name: signal_start
tools.description: Says the run STARTED. Does not clear the dead-man clock: a routine that starts and hangs still becomes a miss. The next success records the duration.

tools.name: signal_fail
tools.description: Says the run FAILED. The ingest never sends e-mail: the 5-minute cron turns it into an alert with reason `fail`, under the same one-per-24h cap.

tools.name: signal_exit_code
tools.description: The shell exit status: 0 behaves like a ping, 1-255 record the code as a failure.

tools.name: ingest_key
tools.description: Returns (minting the first time) the key for /in/<key>/<slug>, where a ping creates its own monitor inside the free tier. Instruments a whole fleet with no setup call per job.

tools.name: ingest_key_rotate
tools.description: Rotates the ingest key; the previous one stops creating monitors. Existing ones keep working.

tools.name: ping_slug
tools.description: Ping that creates its own monitor on the first hit. Same slug = same monitor; 402 when the free tier is full, and then nothing is written.

tools.name: billing
tools.description: Free plan, x402 prices and the trial offer: sign-up with a confirmed e-mail = 90 days without the usage paywall (`trial` field; with a session it shows the state).

tools.name: status_feed_url
tools.description: Public URL (JSON and RSS) with the status of all the owner's endpoints.

tools.name: status_feed_rotate
tools.description: Rotates the status feed token; the previous URL stops working.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Ingest snippets and the JSON HookPulse POSTs on a miss.

tools.name: contact
tools.description: Support. Agent without captcha → 402 $0.10 x402. After the 1st message: 429 + Retry-After (backoff).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "import_crontab" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
